pass_a_gloss: False prophets countered with willed deafness per Ps 38.
pass_b_english: We must expect impiety's prophet too — perhaps not one but more — speaking to us as the Lord's 'word' what the Lord 'commanded not,' or a wisdom-word foreign to wisdom, to kill us with his mouth's word. But even then, when the sinner stands against us, let us say: 'But I as one deaf heard not, and as one dumb who opens not his mouth. And I became as a man who hears not.' (Psalm 38:14–15 (LXX 37)) For deafness toward impious words is fair, when we despair of correcting those who say the worse (Psalm 38:14–15).
